question: What happens to any would-be destroyer after the installation of powers is completed?
premises: The installation of powers has been completed.
The verb jīvet indicates continued life.
inference: Even if a destroyer arises after the installation of powers, that destroyer may live.
uncertainties: The intended force of jīvet in relation to chedakaḥ is ambiguous.
plain_english: When the installation of powers has been done, whoever might become a destroyer may live.
